email.body1:
Michele, saw Celerant unveiled the Customer Engagement Suite and Skylar IQ at NRF 2026 and acquired Saledock to push international.

New products plus a new market usually mean more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that is where growth pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Celerant off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Michele, quick follow-up for Celerant.

Launching a new suite while expanding into the UK usually raises the pipeline bar faster than headcount can follow. Most orgs don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit target, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings Celerant needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Michele, last bit of proof for Celerant.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how Celerant's reply rate likely compares to peer retail-tech firms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Michele, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A product launch plus an international expansion makes for a busy stretch, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your growth motion? I will tailor it to Celerant either way.
